title: Furnaces of the Suzaku
summary: Wang Lin breaks Hongdie's Emotionless Intent Realm with his own Life and Death Intent, and she then tries to blow up her innate spirits to take him with her. Zhu Quezi stops the fight, declares Wang Lin the winner, accepts him into Suzaku Country and the Immortal's Path Sect, and grants him one wish. In the forbidden area Zhu Quezi reveals that he treats talented cultivators as furnaces: Qian Feng absorbs the broken Hongdie, who becomes his second furnace under the name Jue Qing, and Wang Lin is chosen as Liu Mei's future furnace. Liu Mei remembers Wang Lin from her avatar's days in the Xuan Dao Sect in the Country of Zhao. Zhu Quezi also warns that his junior brother Yun Quezi has been training four candidates of his own for the 15th Suzaku title. Badly hurt, Wang Lin leaves for Zhao, but in the far north Li Yuanfeng of the Snow Domain traps him in the Heaven and Earth Devil Sealing Formation, and a second Soul Transformation cultivator joins the ambush.

introduced: Jue Qing (Hongdie as Qian Feng's furnace)
Heaven and Earth Devil Sealing Formation
cultivation: Wang Lin is so badly hurt that he drops to early Soul Formation. Li Yuanfeng reached Soul Transformation as the only survivor of seven Snow Domain Soul Formation elders who escorted Hongdie to Suzaku Country.

flags: What Wang Lin asks for as his wish (415s) is not named; Zhu Quezi grants 'half' of it.
'Qing Dia' at 668s may be a slip for Hongdie or her new name.
The furnace that Yun Quezi freed from Qian Feng is called the 'purple core' (inti ungu, 503s and 997s); possibly Zi Xin (紫芯), who is named in EP89.
The second Soul Transformation cultivator at the end (1254s, 'Saya Tai!') is the Giant Demon Clan ancestor, who is identified in EP83.
